title: Counter Service Tariff: Keys, Key Deposits and Lock Changes on Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
Keys to Safe Deposit Boxes are issued at the start of the lease against a refundable deposit, and a lock change is charged where a key is lost or is not returned.

| Size | Keys issued at lease start | Refundable key deposit | Lock change charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $150.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $150.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | $25.00 | $175.00 |

**Keys issued.** Two keys are issued at the start of the lease, whatever the size of the box.

**The deposit.** The deposit of $25.00 is charged when the keys are issued and is refundable. It is the same figure for all six sizes, so the deposit charged on a 3x5 Safe Deposit Box and on a 10x20 Safe Deposit Box is identical.

**The lock change charge.** This is the charge for changing the lock after a key is lost or is not returned. It is the only figure in this tariff entry that moves with the size, taking $125.00 on the three smallest sizes, $150.00 on the 10x10 and 10x15 Safe Deposit Boxes, and $175.00 on the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box.
